entries.name: On Attack / On Crit / On Evade

system.description: Protected from Decay and Shadow damage. Vulnerable to Slashing, Fire and Holy damage.

Erupt a vomit of ichor at a target. Hit or miss, the square that the target is occupying is covered in an ichorous pool. The square counts as difficult terrain, reducing its occupant's Eva and Def by 4 and Res by 2, and dealing 4 Decay damage each turn to one that begins their turn on it. This pool persists for 3 rounds.
